# SurfaceParticleScan

`import { SurfaceParticleScan } from '@a3d/a3d-components/map'`

Borrowed geometry in host-local metres (X east, Y up, Z south).

## Example

```ts
const scan = new SurfaceParticleScan(() => map.triggerRepaint());
scene.add(scan);
scan.setData({ buildings: [], meshes: [] });
scan.setOptions({ enabled: true });
// Host supplies shared depth, full-height surfaces and tick(deltaSeconds).
scan.dispose();
Owns points only. Host owns map/scene/camera, depth buffer and animation scheduling.
```
